provenance.method: hand-labelled; OPENAI_API_KEY unavailable in the worker process
provenance.selection: Six task categories from the worst discovery notes; no confirmation results used to select or tune proposals. Deformable uses the fixed SPEC substring fixture, which also matches storage via rag.

proposals.name: Deformable objects
proposals.rationale: Hand-labelled discovery theme: moving toward cloth without picking or folding it, and difficulty placing towels. Fixed SPEC substring pattern; rag also matches storage, so this is a broad proxy rather than a clean material taxonomy.

proposals.name: Cups, mugs and bowls
proposals.rationale: Hand-labelled discovery theme: unsuccessful grasping, touching objects without moving them, and incomplete placement into mugs or bowls.

proposals.name: Drawers and articulated access
proposals.rationale: Hand-labelled discovery theme: failure to attempt drawer opening and poorly aligned approaches to the cabinet.

proposals.name: Utensils and stirring
proposals.rationale: Hand-labelled discovery theme: hesitant approaches toward a pot without grasping the spoon, or retracting and freezing after an initial approach.

proposals.name: Small tools and stationery
proposals.rationale: Hand-labelled discovery theme: reaching toward the wrong stationery object, searching near a stapler without grasping, and stalling during pen or screwdriver placement.

proposals.name: Boxes, baskets and trays
proposals.rationale: Hand-labelled discovery theme: frozen attempts at box tasks, moving an incorrect object into a basket, and distractor-sensitive placement of stuffed animals.
